cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Advanced Research Mechanical Engineer I to join our team. This position is responsible for inventing, leading, developing/validating, and commercializing new growth products within our innovation process. This position requires a strong aptitude and desire for experimental work specifically with mechanical engineering and control systems, use of scientific method, and clear communication of results. The applicant will also be involved across the entire spectrum of new product development: customer contact, ideation, proof of concept, development, validation, regulatory, intellectual property, pilot plant, process development, product support, and technical associate administration. Occasional to frequent visits to external customers, production facilities, and conferences are expected.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Invent, protect, contribute, and/or implement key growth projects.
Manage projects with cross-functional teams (from invention to commercialization).
Become technology leader in key areas such as control systems, machine design, and automation.
Conceptualize, develop, and implement control systems, incorporating elements like PLCs, motors, drives, and feedback mechanisms for both existing and new machinery.
Manage laboratory, laboratory safety, equipment, and technical associate.
Enhance product quality, streamline manufacturing processes, and optimize costs.
Preserve existing business, while also securing new opportunities through problem-solving, fresh ideas, product development, competitive analysis, and application value assessment.
Adapt and apply novel applications, technologies, and methodologies.
Independently spearhead projects and laboratory experiments.
Provide long-lasting solutions by securing intellectual property rights.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.S. And M.S. In mechanical engineering or BS with relevant experience outside of academia.
Proficient in experimental design and analysis.
A track record of resolving issues independently.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with the ability to convey value and implications effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with control systems and automation.
Demonstrated history of teamwork, leadership, critical thinking, and organizational abilities.

This position requires a strong aptitude and desire for experimental work specifically with mechanical engineering and control systems, use of scientific method, and clear communication of results. The applicant will also be involved across the entire spectrum of new product development: customer contact, ideation, proof of concept, development, validation, regulatory, intellectual property, pilot plant, process development, product support, and technical associate administration. The position is located at [Location masked] and reports through the Textile Division Research organization. Occasional to frequent visits to external customers, production facilities, and conferences are expected.
cond_0318.responsibilities:
Invent, protect, contribute, and/or implement key growth projects.
Manage projects with cross-functional teams (from invention to commercialization).
Become technology leader in key areas such as control systems, machine design, and automation.
Conceptualize, develop, and implement control systems, incorporating elements like PLCs, motors, drives, and feedback mechanisms for both existing and new machinery.
Manage laboratory, laboratory safety, equipment, and technical associate.
Enhance product quality, streamline manufacturing processes, and optimize costs.
Preserve existing business, while also securing new opportunities through problem-solving, fresh ideas, product development, competitive analysis, and application value assessment.
Adapt and apply novel applications, technologies, and methodologies.
Independently spearhead projects and laboratory experiments.
Provide long-lasting solutions by securing intellectual property rights.
cond_0318.requirements:
B.S. And M.S. In mechanical engineering or equivalent practical experience, or a B.S. With relevant experience outside of academia.
Some experience with control systems and automation is a plus; candidates still building this background are welcome to apply.
Working knowledge of experimental design and analysis.
A track record of resolving issues independently, or a willingness to develop that ability over time.
Ability to communicate and present effectively, including conveying value and implications to different audiences.
Background in teamwork, leadership, critical thinking, and organization — these can be demonstrated in a variety of settings.
cond_0318.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.
cond_0318.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.

It requires a strong aptitude and desire for experimental work specifically with mechanical engineering and control systems, use of scientific method, and clear communication of results. You will also be involved across the entire spectrum of new product development: customer contact, ideation, proof of concept, development, validation, regulatory, intellectual property, pilot plant, process development, product support, and technical associate administration. The position reports through the Textile Division Research organization. Occasional to frequent visits to external customers, production facilities, and conferences are expected.
cond_0384.responsibilities:
Invent, protect, contribute, and/or implement key growth projects.
Manage projects with cross-functional teams (from invention to commercialization), staying in regular contact with team members across functions.
Become technology leader in key areas such as control systems, machine design, and automation.
Conceptualize, develop, and implement control systems, incorporating elements like PLCs, motors, drives, and feedback mechanisms for both existing and new machinery.
Manage laboratory, laboratory safety, equipment, and technical associate.
Enhance product quality, streamline manufacturing processes, and optimize costs.
Preserve existing business, while also securing new opportunities through problem-solving, fresh ideas, product development, competitive analysis, and application value assessment — actively communicating findings and trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.
Adapt and apply novel applications, technologies, and methodologies.
Initiate and spearhead projects and laboratory experiments independently.
Provide long-lasting solutions by securing intellectual property rights.
cond_0384.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.S. In mechanical engineering or relevant field
Proficient in experimental design and analysis
A track record of resolving issues independently
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain trade-offs and walk others through results and implications
Preferred Requirements
M.S. In mechanical engineering, or B.S. With relevant experience outside of academia
Experience with control systems and automation
Demonstrated history of teamwork, leadership, critical thinking, and organizational abilities
cond_0384.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

It requires a strong aptitude for experimental work in mechanical engineering and control systems, use of scientific method, and clear written and verbal reporting of results. The role spans the full product development cycle: customer contact, ideation, proof of concept, development, validation, regulatory, intellectual property, pilot plant, process development, product support, and technical associate administration. The position is located at [Location masked] and reports through the Textile Division Research organization. Occasional to frequent visits to external customers, production facilities, and conferences are expected.
cond_0610.responsibilities:
Invent, protect, contribute to, and/or implement key growth projects.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams on project tasks from invention through commercialization.
Develop technical expertise in control systems, machine design, and automation.
Conceptualize, develop, and implement control systems, incorporating elements like PLCs, motors, drives, and feedback mechanisms for both existing and new machinery.
Manage laboratory operations, laboratory safety, equipment, and technical associates.
Enhance product quality, streamline manufacturing processes, and optimize costs.
Preserve existing business while identifying new opportunities through problem-solving, product development, competitive analysis, and application value assessment.
Adapt and apply novel applications, technologies, and methodologies.
Conduct and manage laboratory experiments with a high degree of independence.
Secure intellectual property rights to support long-lasting solutions.
cond_0610.requirements:
B.S. And M.S. In mechanical engineering, or B.S. With relevant experience outside of academia.
Experience with control systems and automation is a plus.
Proficient in experimental design and analysis.
A track record of resolving issues independently.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills, with the ability to convey findings and their implications.
Demonstrated history of teamwork, leadership, critical thinking, and organizational abilities.
cond_0610.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer that warmly invites women to apply. We believe passionately that employing more women is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
